verification_summary.support: Open bearing-rig data and the associated measurement regime are directly relevant to public vibration-data provenance.
verification_summary.limitation: Publisher landing was not used as the sole current source; registry and institutional record agree.

verification_summary.support: Open raw/processed data are linked to accelerometer, load, speed, and temperature measurements with stated sampling and units.
verification_summary.limitation: The dataset is constant-load/speed and does not by itself establish cross-laboratory reproducibility.

verification_summary.support: Public multi-sensor data expose bearing fault conditions, load variation, channel units, and sampling rates.
verification_summary.limitation: The public record documents acquisition context but does not alone establish calibration uncertainty for every channel.

verification_summary.support: Public raw vibration signals span bearing types, defect combinations, loads, duration, and sampling rate.
verification_summary.limitation: The source emphasizes dataset construction; calibration traceability and repeatability need separate audit.

verification_summary.support: Public bearing data for independent cart systems provide a non-identical target context for cross-platform checks.
verification_summary.limitation: Transfer to other rigs remains a hypothesis until decisive cross-platform measurement checks are performed.

verification_summary.support: A public real-world monitoring dataset combines accelerometers, tachometer, temperature, and environmental variables around bearing damage scenarios.
verification_summary.limitation: Wind-turbine structure and environmental variation are not equivalent to a laboratory bearing rig.

verification_summary.support: An open rotating-system dataset records synchronized vibration, current, temperature, and speed under repeated operating scenarios including bearing degradation.
verification_summary.limitation: The data target is a broader electromechanical system, so bearing-specific traceability must be isolated.

verification_summary.support: A current official repository record establishes a public Paderborn Bearing Dataset identifier and dataset work type.
verification_summary.limitation: The repository metadata retrieved in this run did not expose a complete measurement description; use only for availability and provenance.

verification_summary.support: The official record documents accelerometers, speed/load combinations, damage severities, temperature, and endurance acquisition.
verification_summary.limitation: The repository is large and was not downloaded; claims remain at official-description level.

verification_summary.support: The official record names ICP accelerometers, sensitivity, DAQ context, and synchronized vibration/acoustic measurements.
verification_summary.limitation: Drive-train sensor data are a bridge for provenance, not direct evidence of bearing UQ on the target rig.

verification_summary.support: The calibration study reports traceability and expanded uncertainty across 5 Hz–10 kHz with a stated comparison to primary standards.
verification_summary.limitation: It is a calibration-laboratory study, not a public rolling-bearing dataset validation.

verification_summary.support: The study explicitly separates repeatability, refit reproducibility, sensor position, frequency bands, and Gage R&R limits for rolling-bearing vibration quality control.
verification_summary.limitation: The numeric limits are study-specific and must not be transferred as universal acceptance thresholds.

verification_summary.support: A Gage R&R study makes low repeatability/reproducibility and lack of reference bearings an explicit measurement-system limitation.
verification_summary.limitation: Publisher access was intermittently restricted in this run; current registry metadata and publisher search record agree.

verification_summary.support: The paper applies standard uncertainty to rolling-bearing vibration time series and relates uncertainty variation to failure diameter.
verification_summary.limitation: The venue and experimental scope are narrower than a general public-data calibration protocol.

verification_summary.support: The study estimates time-varying intervals for rolling-bearing vibration performance and checks interval coverage against a confidence level.
verification_summary.limitation: The model-based uncertainty is not a substitute for sensor calibration or repeatability evidence.

verification_summary.support: The proceedings paper evaluates feature repeatability/reproducibility and propagates uncertainty across sensor, DAQ, and processing stages.
verification_summary.limitation: The application is laser Doppler vibrometry and washing-machine diagnostics rather than rolling-bearing accelerometry.

verification_summary.support: Cross-domain bearing diagnosis establishes operating-condition distribution shift as a practical validation boundary.
verification_summary.limitation: High diagnostic accuracy in source studies does not prove measurement traceability or target-domain transfer.

verification_summary.support: Uncertainty-weighted domain generalization is a method bridge for unseen bearing conditions and explicit predictive uncertainty.
verification_summary.limitation: The method evidence concerns model uncertainty and does not close physical measurement UQ prerequisites.

duplicate_or_excluded_discovery_observat.reason: Two repository versions of VBL-VA001 were discovered; neither was needed after the journal and single official-record coverage was assembled.
Preprint-only observations were not used when the journal or official data record was available.
